title: For I'm building a people of power

lines.text: For I'm building a people of power
And I'm making a people of praise,
Who will move through this land by my Spirit,
And will glorify my precious name.
In the Kingdom of your Son !

chords:
[Verse 1]
For I'm [D]building a people of power
And I'm [Bm]making a people of praise,
Who will [Em]move through this land by my Spirit,
And will [A]glorify my precious name.

[Chorus]
Oh [D]build your church, Lord !
Make it [F#m]strong, Lord !
Join our [G]hearts, Lord,
Through your [D]Son.
Make us [G]one, Lord,
In your [D]body,
In the [A]Kingdom of your [D]Son !
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
For I'm building a people of power
And I'm making a people of praise,
Who will move through this land by my Spirit,
And will glorify my precious name.

[Chorus]
Oh build your church, Lord !
Make it strong, Lord !
Join our hearts, Lord,
Through your Son.
Make us one, Lord,
In your body,
In the Kingdom of your Son !
